q1-years.title: Scoring population / years for apples-to-apples
q1-years.imperative: Which event population should the model pi be scored on, given the committed bundle is trained LOSO 2018-2024 (eval 2025) but the ceiling harness pools 2018-2025 normal weekends?
q1-years.finding: ADMIRAL RULING Q1=(c): Score BOTH populations; harness ceiling RECOMPUTED on the EXACT same event set in each case (model and ceiling always share identical pairs). HEADLINE = 2018-2024 LOSO-fold-held. CLEAN-OOS confirmation = 2025-only (ceiling recomputed 2025-only too). No pooling across the two regimes.

q2-infer-path.title: Inference path vs retrain stop-condition
q2-infer-path.imperative: Confirm using run.py 'backtest latent-power-module --emit-module-record' on committed gold bundles (bounded inference, no retrain) is the sanctioned path and does not trip the retrain stop-condition.
q2-infer-path.finding: ADMIRAL APPROVED Q2: run.py 'backtest latent-power-module --emit-module-record' inference on existing committed gold bundles is NOT a retrain -- proceed. ANNOTATION: if any single bundle's inference pass exceeds ~1 hour wall-clock, STOP and report rather than grinding.

q3-recent-drag.title: Recent-history drag (axis i) definition
q3-recent-drag.imperative: Define 'marginal contribution of recent-history channel': standalone same-pairs accuracy of the recent-history quali module vs race-weekend module, or the fusion-combined delta?
q3-recent-drag.finding: ADMIRAL APPROVED Q3: standalone same-pairs accuracy per channel (race_weekend vs recent_history) is the PRIMARY drag number. Fusion-combined delta is corroboration ONLY if committed fusion artifacts support it WITHOUT retraining. ANNOTATION: if they don't support it cheaply, report the standalone number alone and STATE THAT EXPLICITLY -- do not approximate the fusion delta.

q4-entity-scope.title: Entity scope: driver vs constructor
q4-entity-scope.imperative: Confirm driver_quali is the primary deliverable (the ceiling harness targets driver Q order); constructor_quali secondary/optional.
q4-entity-scope.finding: ADMIRAL APPROVED Q4: driver_quali PRIMARY; constructor_quali only if cheap AND it sharpens the recent-history story.

q5-dual-ceiling.title: Dual-ceiling slice and rank-blend tc gating
q5-dual-ceiling.imperative: Confirm dual-ceiling comparison: model vs (a) best_across_fp 0.7968 and (b) blend_rank 0.8029, and that the (b)-(a) slice plus model gap decides whether the deferred #379 rank-blend triage candidate fires.
q5-dual-ceiling.finding: ADMIRAL APPROVED Q5: dual ceiling per standing order -- model vs (a) best_across_fp (~0.7968) AND (b) blend_rank (~0.8029) on SHARED pairs. The (b)-(a) slice prices deferred #379 Part B; the routing verdict decides whether that gated rank-blend triage candidate FIRES.
